reasoning: Predicted pipeline is a single deterministic compression_jpeg:1 verified bit-exactly (PSNR=inf, CI 10/10) on the target and all 4 distinct support pairs, which uniquely rules out blur, noise, and global degradation (peeled residual identically zero; variance_ratio=1.0026, mean_shift=0.0, chroma_ratio=0.9933). Under Section 六/七 signal gating, the only Tier S/A signal fired is block_boundary=2.5752 (JPEG, 0% FP); the Tier A gates that would license architecture components — anisotropy>1.7 (OCAB) and variance_ratio!=1.0 (ColorPre/FiLM-GCM) — are NOT met. Therefore the safe, evidence-backed choice is pure Swin (attention_type=swin, window_size=8, embed_dim=64, 454K) + SimpleGate (default-on per exp39, 8/9 safe, -32K; its one negative case is motion x3 which is absent) with all other components off (GCM, ColorPre, ColorMLP, ColorMLP-Output, ChannelCurve, CSN, DualBranch, PCP, SCA, GDFN, FPro). Training is Direct from scratch on the predicted degradation (no pretrained checkpoint available; exp37/38 show True Ft ~= Direct at this budget anyway), 2 epochs, lr=5e-4, batch=16. Note full_analysis.json's generic recommended_architecture suggests DualBranch, but that heuristic assumes multi-step/uncertain degradation and predates the reflection's bit-exact single-step resolution; Section 七/exp37 explicitly disqualify DualBranch under blind recognition, so it is not adopted. SimpleGate epoch-2 instability was observed only on D3 (JPEG+blur) at 128x128; with JPEG-only severity 1 and lr=5e-4, risk is low — retain best-checkpoint selection from the training log as a precaution.
